glosses: to wash away (often used as a converb, followed by aparmaq (“to carry away”))
yarn ball, clew (of thread), ball of wool

o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یومق (yumaq), from Proto-Turkic *yu(b)- (“to wash”). Cognate with Turkish yumak, Chuvash ҫу (śu) etc.
Derived from Proto-Turkic *yum (“round”), whence also yumru, and perhaps also yumurta. Cognate with Turkish yumak. See there for more cognates.
From Proto-Common Turkic *etek. Cognate with Turkish etek.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish فریاد (feryād), from Classical Persian فَرْیَاد (faryād).
From Proto-Common Turkic *tüŋür (“relative by marriage”). Cognate with Turkish dünür.
